pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sati karaṇīye senaṃ gantvā atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā senāya vasissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.5: amhākampi alābhā amhākampi dulladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu puttadārassa kāraṇā senāya paṭivasāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekatirattaṃ senāya vasissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.13: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:1.15.1: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo senaṃ gamanāya dvirattatirattaṃ tena bhikkhunā senāya vasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttariṃ vaseyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.1.1: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo senaṃ gamanāyāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.1.6: catutthe divase atthaṅgate suriye senāya vasati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.2.1: atirekatiratte atirekasaññī senāya vasati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.2.2: atirekatiratte vematiko senāya vasati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.2.3: atirekatiratte ūnakasaññī senāya vasati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc49:2.3.4: dve rattiyo vasitvā tatiyāya rattiyā purāruṇā nikkhamitvā puna vasati
